Maya (Design): quick check 0 for the Dashboard > Project Settings form: i'm leaning toward inline errors + a compact top summary banner when multiple fields fail on save. reactions? :thinking:
Alex (PM): inline makes fixes fast. top summary helps when a user scans away and misses inline errors. fine with both but don't want needless duplication.
Tariq (Eng): inline + compact top summary is straightforward. we can autofocus the first invalid field. should the summary be aria-live?
Sam (Accessibility): yes. summary should be a role="status" polite aria-live region. also announce each inline error on blur/submit and move focus to summary on submit when multiple errors.
Maya (Design): microcopy options: A) inline messages like "Please enter a valid URL" with asterisk required marker B) show the word "Required" after the label C) short helper-line inline. which is clearest?
Jordan (DesignOps): prefer explicit "Required" for global clarity and localization. asterisk alone is too subtle and can get lost for some locales or screen reader flows.
Alex (PM): product prefers minimal noise. asterisk covers many power users; but agree to show explicit "Required" during focus/after failed submit.
Tariq (Eng): small note: rendering the visible "Required" for every required field increases DOM churn. we can keep aria-required=true and visually hide the word for sighted users, exposing it to SRs, but that hurts discoverability.
Sam (Accessibility): aria-required alone isn't discoverable for sighted keyboard users. recommend a legend at the top: "Fields marked * are required" and make "Required" visible for longer/complex forms.
Maya (Design): suggested compromise: always show a legend at the top, use * by default, but reveal visible "Required" text when field is focused or after a failed submit. keeps UI cleaner while surfacing info when relevant.
Alex (PM): sounds practical. can we get mocks?
Maya (Design): i'll drop mocks in #design-assets later today.
Tariq (Eng): on destructive actions: delete project modal. current copy "Delete project permanently?" plus red button. do we want typed-confirm everywhere?
Jordan (DesignOps): differentiate by risk. org-level deletes require typed-confirm; small personal/test projects only need a confirm modal with undo.
Sam (Accessibility): typed-confirm is ok if we manage focus (label + input) and don't rely on color. ensure ESC cancels, buttons are reachable by keyboard.
Maya (Design): copy options for typed-confirm: 1) "Type DELETE to confirm permanent removal of this project." 2) "Type the project name: example-project". pros/cons?
Alex (PM): typing the project name is safer to stop accidental deletes but more friction. use name for high-risk org-level deletions, "DELETE" for mid-risk, none for low-risk.
Tariq (Eng): implement note: check typed-confirm case-insensitively, trim whitespace, allow paste but log paste events for audit. we should rate-limit attempts.
Jordan (DesignOps): log paste attempts and present a short consequences summary above the input: "This will permanently delete all project artifacts and cannot be recovered."
Maya (Design): a11y nit: modal should use role=dialog, aria-modal=true, trap focus, and focus the heading then the input so screen readers hear context first.
Sam (Accessibility): also make typed-confirm errors announced with aria-live="assertive" and provide clear inline error text like "Text does not match project name".
Tariq (Eng): timeline: reuse Dialog component, add typed-confirm variant + a11y attributes, estimate 2 days for implementation and testing across NVDA/VoiceOver + browsers.
Maya (Design): decision checklist?
Alex (PM): - Use inline errors + compact top summary with aria-live: agree.
Alex (PM): - Required markers: legend + asterisk; show visible "Required" on focus/failed submit: agree.
Alex (PM): - Delete flow: risk-tiered; typed-confirm for high-risk; project-name confirm for org-level; log paste: agree.
FormBot: automated note: created task #UI-3247 "Settings form validation & delete flows" assigned to @Tariq (Eng), @Maya (Design). due 2026-04-02.
Tariq (Eng): thanks 0 i'll start on dialog and error-live region. ping if mocks change.
Jordan (DesignOps): i'll coordinate with localization on "Required" translations and legend phrasing.
Sam (Accessibility): i'll draft an a11y test checklist and post it here.
Maya (Design): quick follow-up: should the summary banner include a "View" action that jumps to the first invalid field? e.g., "2 errors 449 View"
Alex (PM): yes, "View" should focus the first invalid field and the banner should have aria attributes to describe number of errors.
Tariq (Eng): will wire the View action to first-invalid-field id and ensure aria-describedby connects the banner and the field.
Maya (Design): cool 44D closing loop once mocks are in.
